content.text: Chartist, Newton-style (simulated): NVDA last 204.47, right at the 200-day average of 204.28. That is the first line in the sand. Below it, the 60-day low at 207.25 has already given way, so next reference is the 52-week low at 164.27, a big gap if 204 fails. RSI14 at 34.9 shows downside momentum but no oversold extreme yet, and DeMark daily buy setup is only 1 of 9, countdown 4 of 13, so an exhaustion signal is not close. Weekly buy setup at 3 of 9 is more advanced. What changes the view: a daily close back above the 20-day low turned resistance at 210.18, or a completed DeMark 9 count, would argue the slide is stalling.

question.text: Where is support if this keeps falling, and what would change the view?
